url-index GSI, Select COUNT, paginated

span.p:
purgeArticleContent url
list + delete canonical body, rehosted images,
every tier source + sidecar, every version snapshot
CDN edge copies may outlive it ~24h, no invalidation

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
tombstoneArticle url, now
set-once purgedAt, crawl=ready, summary=skipped
content-purged, title/siteName re-stubbed to hostname
REMOVE every content-bearing column
row itself survives so ids resolve to 'removed'

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Why ALL savers, not others:
a version delete leaves the remover's queue row.
Excluding them would purge + tombstone an article
they still own — and reader-permalink's invariant is
'a tombstone can't coexist with an owning row'.
